table.title: Table Showing the Latest Likin Revenue.
footnotes: Remarks: 1. The above figures, in most cases, are compiled from the direct reports of the Provinces for 1924. Where these statistics are not available, the figures supplied by the Ministry of Finance are adopted, as in the case of Fengtien, Kwangtung and Kwangsi.
2. As the classification of revenue is not uniform in all the Provinces, many taxes, though not so designated, really are of a transit nature. Hence they are included under likin.
3. To the total of $68,618,648.00 is to be added $2,459,340.00 the goods tax collected along the railways in 1922 which is really a transit tax, thus making the grand total of $71,077,988.00.
